Package gui

Class GameApp

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
gui.GameApp
public class GameApp extends javafx.application.Application
Main JavaFX Application class that drives the entire game UI.

Manages all scene transitions (start, how-to-play, opening, level-select, game, reward, lose, and completion screens), renders the tile-based game board on a Canvas, and delegates game logic to GameEngine and GameSession.
